headline: Approved the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan and the September 2026 Financial Report.
summary: Chair Tim Surrette and Member Shelly Okere were recognized for their years of service. A one-year probationary contract for a Bangor High School teacher was approved, along with 10 extra-duty assignments for 2026-2027. Donations to several schools, including $7,925 in iPad cases from Biddeford Schools, were also approved.
decisions: Approved the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, 7-0.
Approved the draft minutes of the October 15, 2026 regular meeting, 7-0.
Approved a one-year probationary contract for Beth Middlecamp as a Special Ed (SC) Teacher at Bangor High School for 2026-2027, 7-0.
Approved 10 extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 school year, 7-0.
Approved the donations shared by Committee Member Sara Luciano to schools and the school department, 7-0.

# MINUTES

## BANGOR SCHOOL COMMITTEE

## REGULAR MEETING

7:00 p.m., Wednesday, October 28, 2026

School Committee Members Present: Chair Tim Surrette, Vice Chair Katie Brydon, Mallory Cook, Sara Luciano, Shelly Okere, Ben Speed, and Ben Sprague.

A. 1. & 2. The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m. by Chair Tim Surrette and the pledge of allegiance followed.

3. a. The Bangor School Department and the Bangor School Committee recognized School Committee Chair Timothy Surrette for his nine years of service to the Bangor School Committee.

b. The Bangor School Department and the Bangor School Committee recognized School Committee Member Shelly Okere for her three years of service to the Bangor School Committee.

B. Adjustments to the Agenda:

- D. 2. c. Report of Reassignments
- E. 1. c. 1. Teacher Nomination

Motion: Luciano Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

C. Public Comments:

Adam Goode from Bangor spoke regarding inter-school waivers.

D. 1. a. Recommendation to approve the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan.

Motion: Okere Second: Luciano Vote: 7-0

D. 2. a. Director of Civil Rights, Dana Carver-Bialer, presented an update on the Community of Belonging Advisory Committee.

b. Superintendent Robinson provided a district update to the committee.

c. Superintendent Robinson reported the following reassignments for the 26-27 school year:

- Jeremy Dubois from (.5) Resource Room Teacher and (.5) Self-Contained Classroom Teacher at William S. Cohen School to Resource Room Teacher at William S. Cohen School.
- Samuel Picard from (.5) Resource Room Teacher and (.5) Self-Contained Classroom Teacher at William S. Cohen School to Resource Room Teacher at William S. Cohen School.

E. 1. a. 1. Recommendation to approve the draft Minutes of the October 15, 2026 Regular School Committee Meeting.

Motion: Okere Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

b. 1. Director of Business Services Heather Hale provided a financial update.

2. Recommendation to approve the September 2026 Financial Report.

Motion: Okere Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

c. 1. Recommendation to approve the following teacher nomination for the 2026-2027 school year with a one-year probationary contract:

| Name | Position | School |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Beth Middlecamp | Special Ed (SC) Teacher | Bangor High School |

Motion: Okere Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

2. Recommendation to approve the following extra-duty assignments for the 2026-2027 School Year.

| Name | Assignment | School |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kathleen Young | Freshman Class Advisor | Bangor High School |
| Daniel Considine | Freshman Class Advisor | Bangor High School |
| Daniel Considine | (.5) IEP Coordinator | Bangor High School |
| Lynn Rush | (.25) IEP Coordinator | Bangor High School |
| Brittany Deschaine | (.5) IEP Coordinator | Abraham Lincoln School |
| Casey Quinn | (.25) IEP Coordinator | William S. Cohen |
| Steven Farley | JV Ice Hockey Coach | Bangor High School |
| Laela Martinez | Girls Lacrosse Coach | Bangor High School |
| Katherine Copeland | B Girls Basketball Coach | William S. Cohen |
| Anna MacDonald | (.25) IEP Coordinator | William S. Cohen |

Motion: Okere Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

d. Committee Member Sara Luciano shared the following donations:

- To Vine Street School from My New Shoes St. Paul Apostle Church, sneakers and socks to support students, having a total dollar value of $300.
- To Vine Street School from Charleston Church, winter coats for students, having a total dollar value of $300.
- To Abraham Lincoln School from Charleston Church, winter coats for students, having a total dollar value of $350.
- To Abraham Lincoln School from My New Shoes St. Paul Apostle Church, sneakers and socks to support students, having a total dollar value of $300.
- To Fruit Street School from My New Shoes St. Paul Apostle Church, sneakers and socks to support students, having a total dollar value of $500.
- To Fruit Street School from Charleston Church, winter coats for students, having a total dollar value of $600.
- To Mary Snow School from Treworgy's Apple Orchard, Corn Maze tickets for students, having a total dollar value of $120.
- To Mary Snow School from My New Shoes St. Paul Apostle Church, sneakers and socks to support students, having a total dollar value of $825.
- To Mary Snow School from Hannaford, Apples for Apple Crunch Day, having a total dollar value of $100.
- To Mary Snow School from Charleston Church, winter coats for students, having a total dollar value of $950.
- To Fairmount School from Friends of Fairmount, a cash donation to support students, having a total dollar value of $1,000.
- To William S. Cohen School from St. Paul the Apostle Parish, sneakers to support students, having a total dollar value of $400.
- To William S. Cohen School from Beth Kotredes, sneakers and clothing to support students, having a total dollar value of $200.
- To the Bangor School Department from Biddeford Schools, 91 iPad cases, having a total dollar value of $7,925.
- To the Bangor School Department from RSU 4, 15 Document Cameras, having a total dollar value of $6,786.
- To the Bangor School Department from Second Life Mac, 24 iPad keyboards, having a total dollar value of $384.

Motion: Luciano Second: Brydon Vote: 7-0

F. 3. Member Rigler provided an update from the Bangor High School.

H. Chair Surrette spoke about his time serving the Bangor School Department.

Member Okere spoke about her time serving on the Bangor School Committee.

Member Luciano thanked Chair Surrette and Member Okere for their service.

Member Speed thanked Chair Surrette and Member Okere for their service.

Member Brydon thanked Chair Surrette and Member Okere for their service.

Member Sprague thanked Chair Surrette and Member Okere for their service, and congratulated Vice Chair Brydon for her next term.

Member Cook thanked Chair Surrette and Member Okere for their service and also welcomed new student committee member Rigler.

I. 1. Important dates were reviewed by Chair Tim Surrette.

J. Recommended to adjourn the meeting at 8:33 p.m.

Motion: Okere Second: Surrette Vote: 7-0

Respectfully Submitted,

Marie Robinson, Ph.D.
Superintendent of Schools
